message.content: {"pharmakon_274e":{"rendering":"средство","gloss":"means, instrument, resource","category":"means/aid","note":"Karpov writes 'я изобрел ее, как средство для памяти и мудрости' ('I invented it as a means for memory and wisdom'). It is a neutral means with no medicinal sense. The construction is also recast: Theuth speaks in the first person and 'как' ('as') introduces the word."},"mneme_274e":{"rendering":"памяти","gloss":"memory (genitive/dative, 'for memory')","note":"Appears as 'для памяти', 'for memory'. The Greek objective genitive becomes a purpose phrase. The earlier 'памятливее' ('more mindful of things') also renders mnemonikoteroi."},"sophia_274e":{"rendering":"мудрости","gloss":"wisdom","note":"Appears as 'для ... мудрости', 'for wisdom'. The same root is in 'мудрее' ('wiser') earlier in the sentence."},"pharmakon_275a":{"rendering":"средство","gloss":"means, instrument, resource","category":"means/aid","note":"'ты изобрел средство не для памятования, а для напоминания'. It is the same word as at 274e, so the repetition is kept. The Greek verb is also the same, 'изобрел' / 'изобрел'."},"mneme_275a":{"rendering":"памятования","gloss":"remembering, act of memory (verbal noun)","note":"This is a different word from 274e 'памяти'. The pair is 'памятования' / 'напоминания'. Karpov uses a verbal noun for the activity of remembering, not the faculty. The 'памят-' root still ties it to the earlier word."},"hypomnesis_275a":{"rendering":"напоминания","gloss":"reminding, prompting","note":"A verbal noun from 'напоминать' ('to remind'). It renders hypomnesis exactly. The contrast with 'памятования' is preserved through the prefix on-/на- and the shared root."},"sophia_275a":{"rendering":"мудрость ... не истинную, а кажущуюся","gloss":"wisdom ... not true but seeming/apparent","note":"The structure is recast: 'мудрость ученики приобретут у тебя не истинную, а кажущуюся' ('the students will acquire wisdom from you, not true but seeming'). 'Кажущуюся' is the participle of 'казаться' ('to seem'), so doxa as seeming is kept. The contrast is between true and seeming wisdom, not between doxa and aletheia as nouns."},"doxosophoi_275b":{"rendering":"мнимые мудрецы","gloss":"supposed/imagined wise men","note":"'как мнимые мудрецы, вместо истинных' ('as supposed sages, instead of true ones'). 'Мнимые' means 'imagined, pretended'. It is not the same word as 'кажущуюся' above, so the doxa link is weakened. The compound doxosophoi is split into adjective plus noun. Karpov also has 'многознайками' ('know-it-alls') for polygnomones."},"argument":"Karpov keeps one word, 'средство', for both occurrences of pharmakon, so Thamus does turn Theuth's own word against him. The word is a neutral 'means', so the medicine/poison ambiguity of pharmakon is lost, and the drug/cure imagery vanishes entirely. The argument becomes a plain contrast between a means for memory and a means for reminding, with the same-word irony kept but the pharmacological sense gone."}
